```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tagbio)
library(knitr)
library(pander)

# Load data from UI or running from R/Rstudio

if (is.null(params$tag_data)) {
  # Run from RStudio
  tag_con <- tagConnect()
  fc <- tbl(tag_con)
  
  # might want to select specific fields
  fc_data <- fc %>% collect() 
} else {
  # Run from tag.bio UI
  fc_data <- get_results(params$tag_data)
  parameters <- get_parameters(params$tag_data)
}

```
